summary: Fort Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-binding LOI for a strategic investment and partnership with Logia USA Inc. The proposed deal involves acquiring 50.1% of Logia USA (subject to equity rebalancing), extending a credit facility of up to USD 2 million (with potential for an additional USD 5 million line), and performance-based equity compensation. The partnership aims to provide critical power infrastructure and fuel maintenance solutions for data centers. No definitive agreement has been signed; the transaction remains subject to due diligence, TSX Venture Exchange approval, and negotiation of definitive agreements. This is an early-stage, non-binding preliminary arrangement, not a consummated special situation.
